summary.text: Ayanna Khan-Flowers is the Democratic candidate for Delaware House of Representatives District 9 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Republican Jamar Money in a race with no incumbent.
A business owner, she advanced from the Democratic primary on September 15, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Ayanna Khan-Flowers holds a Bachelor of Science in Criminal Justice from Park University and a Master of Science in Human Services from Wilmington University.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as a mother, business leader, community advocate and candidate, and said she has built her career around service and leadership.
In the survey, Khan-Flowers said her central priorities are supporting small businesses, strengthening the local economy and making life more affordable, including housing and utility costs.
She also said she would advocate for competitive teacher pay, safe and supportive schools, and responsible education funding as District 9 grows.
